bucket_rule: a 1h bucket is kept only when all 60 minutes are present
hours: every hour present in both stores, all months (not a sample)

lost_decision_hours.definition: a decision hour D is lost when [D - window, D) holds an hour whose 1m bucket is incomplete (1 to 59 minutes present)

sealed_policy: hours at or after the sealed start: counts and open times only
tolerance: sum over the 60 minute values of 0.5 * 10^-d_i plus 0.5 * 10^-d_official, d = digits after the decimal point of each string
